capabilities: Calculate time differences between two dates in a timediff code block
Render diffs in a readable format in reading mode
Show the total sum of diffs in a block and per file
Insert timediff blocks and the current time via commands
extras: README is brief and includes standard local development instructions; usage is shown via a code example block.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute and render durations between dates written in a note.
summary: Plugin that calculates and displays time differences between two dates inside a timediff Markdown code block, with a total sum.
